changeSet.author: restaurantos-agent
changeSet.comment: Index supporting the cross-tenant lookup. 058's unique index is (tenant_id, lower(email)) — tenant_id leads, so it cannot serve a probe that has no tenant. Without this index the unified path is a sequential scan of `users` on every login attempt, which is both slow and a denial-of-service lever on an unauthenticated endpoint.

changeSet.author: restaurantos-agent

rollback.sql: REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION auth_lookup_login_candidates(TEXT) FROM auth_user; DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS auth_lookup_login_candidates(TEXT);
